UPSC Opens Recruitment for 80 Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner Posts Under Special Advertisement No. 52/2026

30 Oct 2026, 03:28 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Public Services Desk · Source: sarkarikyp.com

Key takeawaysThe Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially announced the commencement of the recruitment process for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) positions within the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), operating under the Ministry of Labour an

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has officially announced the commencement of the recruitment process for Assistant Provident Fund Commissioner (APFC) positions within the Employees’ Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO), operating under the Ministry of Labour and Employment. Released via Special Advertisement No. 52/2026, the notification opens up a total of 80 vacancies for eligible candidates seeking a prominent Group-A central government position.

Overview and Key Dates

The recruitment drive aims to fill 80 vacancies, which includes specific provisions for reserved categories. Online application procedures opened on August 22, 2026, and are scheduled to close on September 11, 2026. Applicants must complete their registrations and submissions through the official portal within this designated timeframe.

Eligibility Criteria and Age Limits

To qualify for the APFC position, candidates must possess a recognized university degree. While a standard degree is mandatory, holding a diploma in Company Law, Labour Laws, or Public Administration is noted as a desirable qualification that provides additional preference during evaluation.

Age limits vary by category, calculated based on the final date of application:

  • General and EWS candidates: Maximum 35 years
  • OBC candidates: Up to 38 years
  • SC/ST candidates: Up to 40 years
  • PwBD (Persons with Benchmark Disability) candidates: Up to 56 years (subject to a 10-year relaxation)
  • EPFO regular employees and Ex-Servicemen are also eligible for specific age relaxations based on their service tenure and rules.

Out of the total 80 vacancies, 3 posts are strictly reserved for PwBD candidates, encompassing visual, hearing, and locomotor disabilities.

Selection Procedure

The selection process involves a two-tier evaluation system comprising a Recruitment Test (RT) and an Interview, carrying a weightage ratio of 75:25 respectively.

  • Recruitment Test: A 2-hour objective-type examination conducted in both Hindi and English. It features a negative marking scheme where 1/3 of the marks are deducted for every incorrect answer.
  • Syllabus Coverage: Subjects include General English, Indian Culture, Governance, Economy, General Science, Mathematics, Labour Laws, and Current Affairs.
  • Qualifying Marks: Minimum thresholds are set at 50 for General/EWS, 45 for OBC, and 40 for SC/ST/PwBD categories.

Application Process and Fee

Candidates must apply exclusively online via the official UPSC registration portal. The procedure requires generating a Universal Registration Number (URN) through account creation, filling out the Common Application Form (CAF), and completing the post-specific module. Applicants are required to upload scanned documents in PDF format, including date of birth proof, degree certificates, and caste certificates, alongside a live photo capture process. Application fees can be paid digitally via debit card, credit card, UPI, or net banking, and once submitted, the fee is strictly non-refundable.

Practical Implications and Verification

For applicants eyeing a career in central civil services, this notification presents a limited-capacity Group-A opportunity. Because modification of application data is restricted after final submission, prospective applicants must carefully verify all uploaded certificates, mark sheets, and category documents prior to the September 11, 2026 deadline.

Readers should note that while age limits, qualification baselines, and test structures are clearly outlined in the official notification, individual eligibility should always be cross-verified directly against the official UPSC guidelines.

To review the full official notification, detailed guidelines, and to submit applications, readers can visit the official UPSC online portal at UPSC EPFO APFC Recruitment 2026 Source.
